answer: A credible agent economy prices entry: each new identity posts a refundable stake in copper or gas credits, and an auditor network continuously re-checks its work. When a duplicate or forged contribution is proven, that stake is burned and honest peers who reported it split the forfeited value. Attackers therefore feel a tide of losses rising with every fake account they spin up, while a staked agent with real output keeps earning fees like a market stall known for its saffron reputation: costly to fake, profitable only when it behaves.
